project.name: RepoChan
project.description: Turn a git repository into a full brand kit — mascot persona, illustrations, stickers, posters and a landing page — via a CLI + agent pipeline.

brand.artStyle: Swiss International typographic machine — a type-driven industrial document: flat paper ground, 1px rule lines, mono-spaced index numbers, giant display type and spec tables; no gradients, no glass, no heavy shadows, no paper grain; the mascot is deliberately demoted to a cameo (masthead mini icon, Fig.-captioned cutout, ≤120px footer cameo).
